known_issues: Public link displays summary content that is still too short; needs adjustment/expansion.

existing_features.title: Ensure the summary displayed in the deployed/public app link is noticeably longer and more informative when users upload notes, while keeping quiz questions unchanged.

When a webhook is configured and returns a very short summary, automatically generate an expanded client-side summary from the uploaded file text and use that instead (or as a fallback), without changing the quiz array returned by the webhook.
